title: Understanding Full Column Rank
text: A matrix is said to be full column rank if all its columns are linearly independent. This means no column can be written as a linear combination of the others. Think about what this implies for the design matrix X in terms of the foods.

title: Dummy Variables and Linear Independence
text: Consider how the dummy variables for each food item are constructed. If each food is represented by a separate column, what does this mean for the linear independence of these columns?
